projects.name: Sloptoberfest: Hit Tweet and music-video thread
projects.description: A music-video thread opening with "Hit Tweet," an electropop/dancepop experiment made with Suno and Slop Cannon, with an ASCII effect added through Codex.

projects.name: Unpolished Signals Matter More Now | Yohei Nakajima, Untapped Capital
projects.description: On Odin's Going Solo with Dan Gray: building in public, unpolished founder signals, the shared discovery paradox, and keeping investment decisions human.

projects.name: The Playbook That Writes Itself (and Other Ways VCs Are Putting AI Agents to Work)
projects.description: A Venture5 event recording and article with Lindel Eakman and Carta's Scarlett Pierce on agent workflows in venture, a playbook that proposes its own updates, and human decision-making.

projects.name: Soft-to-Rigid: Shape Continuation as an Alternative Search for Packing Congruent Shapes
projects.description: A controlled packing study across 188 instances: gradually hardening soft shapes finds packings rigid searches miss, but tuned rigid starts win more often overall. Every run is replayable.

projects.name: n=12 cube packing: video announcement
projects.description: The October 8 video announcement and raw coordinates behind the separate 12-cube packing project. Novelty relative to Haowei Lin's arrangement remains disputed.

projects.name: Twelve unit cubes in a cube (n=12)
projects.description: A packing of 12 unit cubes in a cube of side 2.9315185094797, found through soft-to-rigid search and checked with exact rational arithmetic. Listed in Friedman's packing catalogue.

projects.name: A sillier way to solve square packing
projects.description: The original video demonstration of soft-to-rigid square packing: 11 squares reached side 3.877 in about 3.75% of the reported runs. A demo preceding the separate controlled study, not a new square-packing record.

projects.name: From BabyAGI to ActiveGraph: Why Long-Running Agents Need Logs, State, and Proof with Yohei Nakajima
projects.description: On ODSC's Ai X Podcast with Jerry Wolfe: the path from BabyAGI to ActiveGraph, durable agent state, auditable logs, and reproducible research.

projects.name: Glance VLM
projects.description: An open-source Python harness that reads typed answers from a local vision-language model's logits and returns probabilities without generation.

projects.name: Beep with JEV

projects.name: JEV Graph Extraction
projects.description: A JEV experiment that scores words for semantic significance, tags relevant words with IDs, and builds a graph from the highest-scoring words.

projects.name: Did OpenAI Steal the Navier-Stokes Solution? | E2335

projects.name: Synthetic Players research
projects.description: A paper and reproducible study asking whether a sixteen-persona LLM panel preserves treatment responses in repeated games, and showing that passing coarse marginal checks is cheap.

projects.name: Remoko
